text_block_list.text:
Special Week seems
a bit down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Lately,
even when I sleep soundly, I just can't shake off this fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even though I'm getting to run in so many of the Twinkle Series races I've always dreamed of...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― B-But please don't worry!
I'm sure, um, I'll be fine in no time!
For the sake of her future success, it seems we'll need to review her race schedule...
